usageNotes: Use this to gracefully shut down all (or a filtered subset of) VMs and containers across the entire cluster in one call. Requires 'VM.PowerMgmt' on '/' for a cluster-wide sweep, or on each '/vms/<ID>' when scoping via the 'vms' parameter. Returns a UPID string — poll the task status endpoint to confirm completion before assuming all guests are down.

examples.summary: Shut down a specific set of VMs with a 5-minute timeout and force-stop fallback, limiting concurrency to 8 workers

destructiveReason: Issues ACPI shutdown signals (and optionally hard-stops after timeout) to every matched guest, terminating all running workloads and making services unavailable until guests are manually restarted.
tips: Omitting 'vms' targets every running guest on the cluster — double-check scope before submitting.

The default 'force-stop: true' (default 1) means any guest that does not shut down within 'timeout' seconds will be hard-killed; set it to false and raise 'timeout' if guests need extra time for graceful shutdown scripts.
Use 'max-workers' to throttle concurrency on large clusters and avoid overloading storage or network during simultaneous shutdowns.
'maxworkers' is deprecated; always use 'max-workers' in new integrations.
Poll the returned UPID via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to confirm all workers finished before declaring the cluster quiesced.
